status: CAD integrated; final eye uses adopted PCB raw hashes; conditional PoC engineering assessment only
minimum_success: Power + Tab5 parallel + Core DDR3 use; HDMI is optional. C HDMI is DNP, no active HDMI pass claimed.
firmware_required: F_HPD Core pad30 is ACTIVE LOW after NPN revision. Configure input only, invert in firmware and debounce >=10ms.
D2 Core TX5_N/P mapping intentionally swapped: invert D2 data bits, never invert TMDS clock.
Initial HDMI target 640x480, pixel clock25.175MHz, TMDS251.75Mbps. 720p742.5Mbps is optional sensitivity only.
Enable HDMI after stable power; HPD is not a guarantee of receiver termination power. No power-rail hotplug guarantee.
Parallel/controller firmware bring-up and physical DDR3 memory test remain required; simulation does not provide working FPGA bitstream.

Receiver terminations45/50/55ohm are correlated P/N; independent mismatch and its DC differential offset are not covered.

Cable loss margin is flat added loss, not actual cable S-parameters. No nonlinear clamps, jitter, crosstalk, PLL or full Core3D.
